tease while riding: the tape becomes visible during the uphill wire grind
the vert finish happens on rooftop ramps (spine transfers) above the city
PS1: tape on the 1,500-point wire; score and secret reinforce each other
2002 hardest letters use two-pool rooftop geometry and a wallride exit
the river is the failure line under the A and a cash icon
cash marks lines (mid-line in 2002, line ends in 2025)
London's events are moving people and vehicles: buses, coppers, police bike, van, relocating constable
goals rehearse the tape route (Constable Richard, 2025 S-K-A-T-E use QP-wire-roof-spine)
2025 hides secrets behind breakable glass and transitions (elevators)
day (2002) to night (2025): lighting becomes route guidance
remakeChanges: Tape: none in 2002; PS1 unlisted tape on the red balcony-to-column wire (1,500); 2025 listed tape above an upper-rooftop QP reached via the column QP and wire

Goals kept: S-K-A-T-E, buses (5 -> 2 in one combo), coppers (5 -> 4 + moving Constable Richard), Free Stompy (nets -> van skitch), fountains (Japan -> Benihana), South Bank lights (amateur -> pro full gap)
Goals dropped: race, flatland goals, competition, Nail the combos, police-bike skitch, 100k combo; added: tape, Impress the Pro Skaters, Stompy plushies
Remake associates the Zoo with London ('WELCOME TO THE ROYAL ZOO' sign in London LP34 1:54:40; 'Zoo - London' heat LP34 4:29:50)
transfer: Monument lift: QP at a monument base -> sloped cable to rooftops; crystal visible from the cable; rooftop spine transfer apex ~2-3 m above coping reaches it
Red wire: crystal on the most valuable/decorated cable from a hidden balcony (vert air into a rail above a QP) to the central landmark
Two-pool drop: crystal ~3-4 m above the lower pool coping between upper and lower rooftop pools; charged ollie (1.78 m high, up to 13.8 m long) from the upper pool lip
River bulb string: long sagging grindable light string over water; crystal at the lowest sag; water respawn on the embankment
Moving bus platform on a loop to wallride/wallie from; crystal on a bus-stop roof reachable only from the bus's height
